data.narrative:
Aalyria, a Series B space and aerospace company founded by Chris Taylor, carries a current post-money valuation of $1.3B following $130M+ in total fundraising. The valuation assessment relies on a comp universe of five public-market anchors (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and eight private peers, including Cowboy Space Corporation, Sierra Space, and Skyryse.

Two triangulation methods apply directly. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $1.3B base, yielding $2.5B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B Series B), Sierra Space ($8.0B Series C), and Skyryse ($1.1B Series C)—produces a $2.0B median valuation, with a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied; the Space & Aerospace sector median P/S multiple is 24.6x across six public tickers, but Aalyria's revenue is not disclosed, precluding meaningful application.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.7B to $2.8B, with a median of $2.2B—a 69% step-up from current valuation. This implies modest upside from the last round. Key uncertainties include stage-specific step-up variability, peer heterogeneity (Sierra Space trades at a $8B outlier), and the absence of revenue data limiting public-market calibration.
